headline: Vote In The 2026 Book Review Contest
author: Scott Alexander

paragraphs.text: If you’ve read the finalists of this year’s non-book review contest, vote for your favorite here. Voting will close end of day on Friday, November 20. This year is approval voting; check the box for all reviews you like.
In case you need a refresher, here are the finalists, in order of appearance:

1: The Book of Abraham2: Great and Desperate Cures3: Breakdown in Pakistan4: The Epic of Gilgamesh5: The Escape Artist6: A Residence of 21 Years in the Sandwich Islands7: Thomas Urquhart’s Translation of Rabelais8: The Tale of Genji9: This is Going to Hurt10: Lee Kuan Yew’s Memoirs11: We Present Television12: Storm of Steel13: The Ghost in My Brain14: The History and Adventures of an Atom15: Orality and Literacy
Prediction market is here, but don’t peek until after you’ve voted.
